status_reason: All claims share the same technical contribution – a coexistence device for upgrading an OLT – satisfying the unity requirement under Norwegian Patents Act §10 and Patent Regulations §8

grouping.technical_subject_matter: Coexistence device (Cex) with multiple first interfaces, optical filters and splitter for simultaneous transmission of several frequency bands in an upgraded OLT
grouping.objective_technical_problem: Provide a device that enables coexistence of legacy and next‑generation PON signals over existing OLT infrastructure without loss of service
special_technical_features: multiple first interfaces for connecting to OLT and ODNs
arranged first, second and third optical filters with pass/reflect functions
integrated splitter directing split signals to respective interfaces
dual‑unit configuration separating first and second Cex units

technical_relationship_analysis: The common features listed above are not generic background elements but constitute a coordinated arrangement that solves the same technical problem across all claims. The specific combination of multiple interfaces, reflective/pass‑through optical filters and the integrated splitter creates a special technical effect – simultaneous handling of different frequency bands – which links the dependent claims to the independent claim and to each other, thereby forming a single general inventive concept.
legal_mapping: Under Norwegian Patents Act §10 an application must contain a single invention; Patent Regulations §8 requires that claims share a special technical feature linking them. The identified special technical features satisfy this requirement.
recommendation: Proceed with examination on the basis of a single inventive concept and consider grant if novelty and inventive step are met.

exemplar_analogies_used.one_line_summary: The Board held that method and apparatus claims formed a single inventive concept when the apparatus provided essential technical means solving the same objective problem as the method.
exemplar_analogies_used.mapping: Analogously, the Cex device (apparatus) and its method of operation share the same technical solution, supporting unity.
